{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing)
# and rows where revenue is '999,999.99' (QA orders)
# Also ensure we only consider converted customers

df_clean = df[  
    (df['customer_age'] != -1) &  
    (df['revenue'] != '999,999.99') &  
    (df['converted'] == 1)  
]

# Now compute the mean age of converted customers from real orders
mean_age_converted = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding missing age and QA rows): {mean_age_converted}")"}
